description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

While some companies count on marketing and sales to gain market share, we are a product-led company and we are investing primarily on building an innovative and scalable platform. Tech teams have a crucial role to play to achieve this goal.

 

👪 Team and context

You’ll work within a DevOps team currently composed of 4 engineers, reporting to the Engineering Manager.

 

You’ll collaborate closely with 300+ engineers to define and elevate performance, reliability and observability standards across the organization.

 

You’ll be embedded in multidisciplinary product teams (Frontend & Backend), working closely with another DevOps Engineer and an Application Security Engineer.

 

This is a high-impact role : you’re joining early and will help shape how reliability works at scale.

 

🏠 Offices

The company's HQ are in Paris, but the whole Tech team is remote-first. You are thus free to work from wherever you want in Europe.

 

🎯 Your Missions

 

  • Evangelize and simplify SRE practices across our engineering organization (300+ engineers).

  • Proactively identify reliability and performance improvement opportunities - not just react to incidents.

  • Define and evolve performance, metrics and observability standards (SLIs/SLOs, monitoring frameworks, alerting strategies).

  • Scale production resources efficiently while ensuring resilience and cost awareness.

  • Design, implement and continuously improve tooling and monitoring systems.

  • Contribute to engineering guidelines and best practices around reliability and production excellence.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Backend, Security and Platform stakeholders to embed reliability by design.

 

🥇 You're the right candidate if you have experience :

  • Working with cloud environments (we use AWS).

  • Building and evolving observability and monitoring systems (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or similar).

  • Scaling production systems and web applications, including asynchronous job systems.

  • Operating in high-growth or product-led environments.

  • Influencing engineering teams and driving reliability practices at scale.

 
 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to

💵 You’ll have a compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your english or your french

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to Centerparcs and it was fabulous !)

 

And.. If you're based in France :

 

🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris

🏝You’ll get between 8 to 13 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year

🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day

🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

What does the recruitment process look like ? 

 

  • Intro call with Technical Recruiter (30 min)

  • Technical interview (1h)

  • System design interview (1h)

  • Final discussion with the Tech Leadership (1h)

Encouraging diversity in all its forms, Pennylane strives to offer an inclusive, caring and fulfilling work environment in our offices and remotely. We provide equal opportunities and consideration regardless of background, origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation or handicap.

We are seeking an exceptional, impact-oriented Strategy & Operations professional who will be instrumental in building these critical capabilities and propelling our electronic invoicing track toward market leadership.

 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

The Strategy & Operations role will serve as the critical link between our strategic vision and day-to-day execution, working directly with the General Manager for the track. You will help translate ambitious goals into actionable, measurable roadmaps, establish best-in-class metrics, and develop the operational infrastructure needed to scale the business rapidly and sustainably.

 

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with significant opportunity for leadership and professional growth.

Strategic planning and execution

- Partner with the product leadership to define, prioritize, and implement operational roadmaps aligned with business objectives

- Design and establish scalable operational frameworks that support our growth

 

Data-driven decision making

Project leadership

- Identify and manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

- Facilitate effective collaboration and alignment across organizational boundaries

 

Performance management

- Design and implement robust tracking mechanisms to monitor performance against key metrics

- Proactively identify performance gaps and develop action plans to address them

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations or a related field, with a strong record of scaling business operations in dynamic environments

- Proven track record of translating strategic initiatives into executable operational plans and projects, delivering measurable business impact

- Proficiency in SQL (or willingness to learn) and modern data analysis tools to drive decision-making independently

 

Core competencies

- Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals

- Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes

- Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation

- Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders

- Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions

⚠️ This role is Paris-based only, and unfortunately we're not able to offer a fully remote setup.

You'll need to be fluent in both French and English for this role.

- An interview with Antoine - General Manager RFE (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at

Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

title: Flight Mechanics Engineer - System Identification
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a Flight Mechanics Engineer - System Identification, working out of Zurich, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

 

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: AI Robotics Engineer
description:
inspire AG is the leading Swiss competence centre for product innovation and advanced manufacturing. As a strategic partner of ETH Zurich, our mission is to transfer knowledge and technology from research to Swiss machine, electrical and metal industries. The research group Intelligent Production Systems at inspire is based in Lugano, the southern part of Switzerland.

Our research group focuses on the development of AI algorithms for industrial applications. The main scope of our activities is the optimization and automation of workflows and production systems. Within this field, we are continuously developing and adopting various algorithms for multiple applications such as automating quality control, detecting process deviations and finally predicting the resulting product quality of the production systems.

We are looking for somebody to further push the activities around humanoids, dual-arm robots and mobile manipulators and we want to move fast. Our goal: automate industrial tasks that are still done by hand today, such as assembly, machine tending, handling and inspection, by combining modern robot hardware with AI for perception, manipulation and task learning.

You will have the opportunity to lead own topics and push the current boundaries. The role is like being part of a startup, but with the backing of an established research institute, connections to ETH Zurich and a strong network of Swiss industrial partners.

We are looking for a hands-on, highly proactive builder with an entrepreneurial mindset: someone who spots opportunities and gets a robot doing something useful within weeks. This position sits at the interface between research and industry.

Your Tasks

  • Build and own robotic demonstrators end to end, from concept to a working system on real hardware

  • Develop AI for quality control, perception and manipulation for industrial tasks

  • Integrate and program robot platforms (humanoids, dual-arm robots, cobots, mobile manipulators) using ROS 2, motion planning and simulation tools

  • Scout the fast-moving humanoid and embodied AI landscape: evaluate platforms, foundation models and suppliers and translate trends into concrete opportunities for Swiss industry

  • Identify automation use cases with industrial partners and run feasibility studies and pilots directly on the shop floor

  • Take ideas from concept to launch

  • Coordinate industry and grant projects, both technically and organizationally

Required qualifications & experiences

  • A PhD in robotics or mechanical or electrical engineering, or a Master's degree with an outstanding track record

  • Hands-on experience with real robot hardware, not only simulation

  • A proven track record in robot learning, perception or manipulation is a plus

  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++, and experience with ROS/ROS 2

  • Solid experience with deep learning frameworks and robot simulation (e.g. Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo)

  • Experiences in applied research, industrial R&D or a robotics startup

  • A startup or entrepreneurial mindset: you take initiative, ship prototypes fast and make things happen rather than waiting for direction

  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities, combined with a structured, solution-oriented way of working

  • The ability to turn technical ideas into projects

  • Excellent English, plus fluency in at least one of German, Italian or French; a further national language is an advantage

  • CH/EU/EFTA citizenship or a valid Swiss work permit

We offer

  • The chance to push robotics activity with real ownership

  • Access to robot hardware and lab infrastructure to test ideas quickly

  • Exciting topics and projects spanning academia and industry, at the forefront of AI for manufacturing

  • A flexible working culture with self-organized job execution and short decision paths

  • Close cooperation with industrial partners and the chance to build your own network

  • Participation in conferences, workshops and exhibitions

  • Guidance and internal training from experienced professionals to support your growth

By submitting application documents, you accept the provisions of the privacy policy of inspire.

description:
Title:                                       Systems and Digital Solutions Intern

Type of contract:                   Paid internship

Contract duration:                 6 months   

Work time:                             Full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time

Reporting to:                         Systems and Digital Solutions Coordinator

Technical guidance:              BI and Systems Officer

Location:                                Remote (home-based outside Switzerland)

Start date:                              January 2027

Application deadline:           10/12/2026

 

Background

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty-bearers and the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support for designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work.

 

Role Summary

The Systems & Digital Solutions Intern provides part-time operational support across GSF’s systems, business intelligence, data quality, information management and IT support services. The intern contributes to first-line user assistance, routine administration, testing, documentation, data cleansing and validation, and the organisation of information within GSF Online, SharePoint and other approved systems. Assignments are prioritised through a six-month work plan and include a structured handover to support continuity between successive internship placements.

 

Position Responsibilities

Systems and User Support

  • Provide first-line support for GSF Online and other assigned systems, record support requests and contribute to an initial response within one business day;

  • Support routine user-account and access administration under supervision, including approved access requests and periodic access reviews;

  • Assist with system configuration, testing, issue reproduction and validation of fixes or new releases;

  • Escalate unresolved, recurring, security-related or access-control issues promptly.

Data Quality and Information Management

  • Support data cleansing, migration, validation and follow-up of identified data-quality issues;

  • Assist with routine data preparation and testing of Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs under technical guidance;

  • Support consistent organisation of information in SharePoint, GSF Online and other approved systems, including naming, storage and permissions;

  • Maintain clear records of completed checks, identified issues and follow-up actions.

Documentation, Training and Continuity

  • Prepare and update user guides, FAQs, process documentation and training materials;

  • Support system demonstrations, training sessions and user-adoption activities;

  • Complete priority assignments agreed through the six-month work plan and provide regular progress updates;

  • Prepare a structured handover of open tasks, documentation and learning for the next internship placement.

 

Position Requirements

Education and Experience

  • The position is open to students currently enrolled in a master’s program in information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a related field. Please note a tripartite agreement is mandatory for this internship;

  • Interest or initial experience in business systems, data quality, reporting, user support or information management;

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365; experience with Power BI, SharePoint or similar platforms is an asset.

Other Requirements

  • Good written and spoken English; French or another GSF working language is an asset.

  • Analytical, organised and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail and confidentiality;

  • Ability to learn quickly, document work clearly and escalate issues appropriately;

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and predominantly remote environment;

  • Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and responsible use of data and technology.

 

 

How to apply

Please click apply to submit your application by 10th December 2026 (midnight CET).

Kindly note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

____________________________________________________________________________________

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) is dedicated to fostering diversity, gender balance, and inclusion, reflecting the varied landscapes where we operate and the communities we work with. We welcome applications from qualified professionals of all backgrounds, cultures, and beliefs. We particularly encourage candidates from regions where GSF is active to apply.

At GSF, we are committed to enforcing stringent Safeguarding policies, covering protection from exploitation, abuse, harassment, misuse of power, and discrimination, as well as child safeguarding and financial and fiscal integrity. We uphold a zero-tolerance approach to any form of unacceptable behaviour.

As part of our recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be required to provide references from previous employers and complete a self-declaration.

GSF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, or hiring processes (i.e. application stage, interview stage, validation stage, appointment, or training). GSF will never request applicants’ bank account information.

 

Please note that candidates must be authorised to work in the country where the position is based at the time of application.

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location: London
Contract Type: 12-month contract

Day Rate: £650–£750 per day

We are looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join our Technology team, working onsite with a Tier 1 Bank in London on an initial 12-month contract.

This is a hands-on role focused on designing and delivering scalable, production-ready AI solutions within a complex financial services environment. You will work across business, product, engineering and data teams, taking solutions from initial concept through to deployment and production.

You will have particular expertise in Generative AI and LLM technologies, including RAG, agentic AI, document and unstructured data processing, and machine learning.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong solution architecture expertise with a pragmatic approach to security, governance, scalability and production delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end architecture for AI-enabled solutions, covering applications, data, integrations and production environments.

  • Translate business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions.

  • Select appropriate AI approaches, including Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, machine learning and hybrid solutions.

  • Define APIs, integrations and data contracts across upstream and downstream systems.

  • Ensure security, privacy, resilience and appropriate controls are embedded into solution design.

  • Define non-functional requirements including availability, performance, latency, scalability and cost.

  • Support deployment, monitoring, versioning and ongoing lifecycle management of AI solutions.

  • Work closely with engineering teams to break architecture into deliverable solutions and resolve technical challenges.

  • Produce clear architecture documentation, designs and technical decision records.

  • Identify opportunities to create reusable architecture patterns and components.

  • Manage technical risks, dependencies and architectural decisions throughout delivery.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect within complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong experience designing end-to-end technology solutions across applications, APIs, integration and data.

  • Good understanding of AI and Generative AI architecture, including LLMs and RAG.

title: M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary 

As our M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel, you will work directly under the Head of M&A and Finance Legal Counsel, based in Paris. In close collaboration with our Business and Finance teams, you will play a key role in structuring, drafting and negotiating Mistral’s external growth transactions and equity fundraisings.


Mistral operates at the frontier of AI, where the pace of innovation demands transaction execution speed and precision that match the technology itself. You will help shape the growth and business relationships that will define Mistral’s next chapter.

Key responsibilities

  • Draft, negotiate and advise on a wide range of M&A transactions, including acquisitions, acqui-hires and other internal or external growth projects worldwide.

  • Take an active part in every stage of M&A transactions: deal structuring, due diligence, negotiations, signing and closing.

  • Coordinate the process for Mistral’s equity fundraisings, including legal communication with prospective investors, structuring the company's due diligence disclosure, drafting investment documentation and leading the signing and closing of equity fundraisings.

  • Coordinate and assist on Mistral’s secondary sale transactions on behalf of investors and employees.

  • Draft, negotiate, and advise on transaction documentation, including LOIs, NDAs, SPAs, shareholders' agreements, investment agreements, and other ancillary transaction documents.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including other corporate functions.

  • Build internal templates, practices, and guidelines for M&A and equity financing documentation.

  • Support on other legal topics as needed, particularly on compliance matters related to corporate affairs.

Qualifications and skills

  • Bachelor's degree or above (LLB, LLM or Juris Doctor preferred) from an accredited law school in France or another EU country. Admission to practice law in at least one additional jurisdiction, in particular the USA or the UK, would be a plus.

  • A minimum of 4–5 years of relevant legal experience, including at least 3 years at an international law firm.

  • Substantial experience in M&A, VC and/or equity financing transactions, including hands-on experience working on large- to mid-cap acquisitions, from due diligence through signing and closing.

  • Familiarity with VC/PE-type transaction documentation is highly valued: you understand complex shareholders’ agreements, management and employee incentive packages, as well as the governance dynamics of venture-backed and PE-backed companies.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in both English and French, with a strong ability to present complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.

  • Knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing and their applications.

  • Adaptability: proactive, flexible, eager to learn and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ethical awareness: a strong understanding of ethical considerations related to AI, such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Comptable Dépenses Collaborateurs
description:
Why This Role Exists

Pennylane’s growth and new subsidiaries are increasing employee-expense volumes. This newly created role will own the processing and reliability of expense claims, employee cards, and business travel across the Group’s French and international entities, while contributing to better approval workflows, card controls, and automation.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms. Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You'll Do

  • Answer employee requests and tickets; check receipts, business purpose, travel-policy compliance, and approvals.

  • Verify accounting and analytical coding, VAT treatment and period allocation; record expenses and prepare reimbursements.

  • Follow up incomplete files and manage tool access with People.

  • Process card creation, closure, and limit requests; review transactions and collect missing receipts.

  • Import and reconcile Perk, Uber Business, and other travel-provider data; investigate duplicates, anomalies, and adjustments.

  • Process subsidiary expenses under local rules provided by international accounting.

  • Justify accounts, clear outstanding items, identify unrecorded expenses, and prepare FNP/CCA cut-off entries.

  • Document controls, support audits, and help redesign processes and automate checks.

 

What You Bring

  • Accounting training or equivalent experience, with 1–2 years in employee expenses, accounts payable, or an accounting firm.

  • Good knowledge of VAT rules for expenses and receipt controls.

  • Critical thinking: able to apply, question, and explain rules.

  • Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets; interested in digital tools, AI, and automation.

  • Rigour, service mindset, pedagogy, and confidence enforcing policies.

  • Fluent French and operational English for exchanges with subsidiaries.

  • Knowledge of e-invoicing reform impacts on expense claims is a plus; international experience is not required.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Join Finance’s Internal Accounting team and report to the Associate Team Lead Accounting.

  • Work with People, managers, and Finance as the main contact for employee expenses.

  • Combine operational ownership with cross-functional improvement projects.

 

📍 Location & Contract

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Paris
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) lead complex end-to-end deployments of frontier models in production alongside our most strategic customers. You will own discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout, partnering directly with customer engineering and domain teams.

You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback that changes product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM teams.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will

  • Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production

  • Build full-stack systems that deliver customer value and sharpen how we learn

  • Embed closely with customer teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

  • Scope work, sequence delivery, and remove blockers early

  • Make trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality; adjust plans to protect delivery

  • Contribute directly in the code when progress or clarity depends on it

  • Codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, or building blocks that others can use

  • Share field feedback that helps Research and Product understand where the models succeed and where they can improve

  • Keep teams moving through clarity and follow-through

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

  • Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments

  • Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks

  • Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience

  • Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

  • Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

  • Spot risks early and adjust without slowing down

  • Model calm and judgment when the stakes are high

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

description:

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

The role

As Frontend Engineer you own the web applications people use to run our instrument and read its results: an operator console that configures and runs scans with live camera and stage data, and a reconstruction front-end for setting up runs and inspecting images. Your users are the engineers in our lab, so feedback is immediate. You work closely with the Embedded, Software and Algorithm engineers who build the systems behind your interfaces.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain the frontends of our acquisition and reconstruction applications, from design to release.

  • Develop real-time views of camera images, stage positions and scan progress streamed from the instrument.

  • Design clear, safe operator workflows for configuring and running measurements.

  • Keep a shared design system and component library across our applications.

  • Extend the Python and C# backends where a feature needs it, together with the backend owners.

  • Take part in code review and bring good frontend practice to the team: typing, testing, CI.

Your profile

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • ~3–5 years of experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.

  • Experience with real-time or data-heavy interfaces (WebSockets, streaming data, canvas or WebGL rendering).

  • Strong CSS and a feel for clean, usable interface design.

  • Working knowledge of Python or C# and REST APIs.

  • Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you.

Bonus

  • Experience building software for scientific instruments, industrial machines or other hardware.

  • Experience with image or scientific data visualization.

  • Experience with FastAPI or ASP.NET Core, end-to-end testing (Playwright, Cypress), or working in a Scrum team.

  • Interest in optics, imaging or semiconductor metrology.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the user-facing software of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

  • A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product.

  • Work at the meeting point of software, optics and hardware, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven.

  • A competitive salary for the Dutch market.

title: Associate GEO and SEO Specialist
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on the Demand Generation team, where SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization) is a fast-growing source of pipeline. Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews which maintenance software to consider, and our job is to make sure MaintainX is in that answer and described well. Today the work is run by one person. You'll help make it a team of two.

The role

  • You will turn our SEO and GEO strategy into shipped work, so MaintainX shows up wherever buyers search.

  • Run content refreshes and gap pieces from brief to QA to publish, so priority pages recover and hold their rankings and AI citations.

  • Review backlink and offsite citation prospects to keep every link we earn high quality.

  • Support technical SEO and keyword research, flagging issues and opportunities before they cost us traffic.

  • Be the day-to-day contact for our web, design, content and product teams and outside vendors, turning their requests into clear next steps and following through until the work ships.

  • Design and run experiments with our Senior SEO/GEO Specialist to learn what moves visibility in LLMs, and document what you find.

Most of your partners don't own SEO, so part of the job is explaining why a change matters so they want to make it. Our Senior Specialist will train you on our tools and processes and mentor you. Within 6 to 12 months, you'll own execution on the team's core projects, handle ad hoc requests independently, and propose experiments of your own.

About you

  • 1 to 2 years in SEO, through a role or a strong internship

  • Hands-on keyword research and rank tracking in Semrush, Ahrefs or a similar tool

  • A clear view of how search is changing, including how LLMs surface and cite sources

  • Tests you've run or contributed to, and what you learned from them (side projects exploring GEO count)

  • Experience explaining technical ideas to non-technical teammates and getting them on board

  • The organization to juggle several projects and follow up until each is done

  • Comfort making decisions without a clear answer, because search rarely offers one

  • Nice to have

  • Screaming Frog or other technical audit tools

  • Exposure to GEO and AEO tools such as Profound or AirOps

  • B2B SaaS or demand generation experience

We offer

  • A product worth recommending. Operations teams in factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses already choose MaintainX, so you'll be earning visibility for something customers love.

  • An early seat. GEO is new and our team is small. You'll own real projects from week one and learn from the person who built the playbook.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. As part of Autodesk, we have more resources and reach, pointed at the problem we were already solving.

  • Room to grow. Search is being rewritten right now, and the people who learn it early become the people the company asks.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We test, measure and share what we learn, including what didn't work. You get autonomy, and we expect you to ask early when you're stuck.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

description:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)


Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

As Socketâs first Account Executive in Japan, youâll help build our business in a developing market while bringing software supply chain security to more organizations. Youâll own customer opportunities from initial outreach through close and help establish a repeatable local sales motion.

You'll partner closely with security, engineering, and executive stakeholders while helping shape our regional go-to-market strategy, sales process, and customer expansion efforts.

What You'll Do

  • Build the territory. Identify promising accounts, generate pipeline through outreach and relationships, and follow up on inbound and partner introductions.

  • Own the sales cycle. Lead discovery, develop account plans, align stakeholders, and guide opportunities through commercial negotiations and close.

  • Sell to technical and business audiences. Connect customersâ security and development challenges to Socketâs value, tailoring conversations to engineers, security leaders, and executives.

  • Partner on technical evaluations. Bring Sales Engineering into opportunities early and coordinate customer needs, evaluation milestones, and next steps.

  • Work with local partners. Collaborate with resellers, distributors, and other partners on opportunities and customer relationships alongside Socketâs channel team.

  • Build a repeatable motion. Maintain a clear pipeline and forecast, share what works, and help improve messaging and sales processes for Japan.

  • Bring the market back to Socket. Share customer and partner feedback with Sales, Product, and Marketing, and coordinate a thoughtful handoff to post-sales teams.

What You'll Bring

You bring:

  • A track record of building pipeline and closing B2B software deals against sales goals.

  • Experience selling in Japan and navigating customer relationships and buying processes there.

  • Ability to conduct customer conversations in Japanese and collaborate effectively with colleagues in English.

  • Experience managing the full sales cycle, including complex deals with multiple technical and business stakeholders.

  • Ability to explain a technical product clearly, uncover customer needs, and work effectively with technical specialists.

  • Experience creating opportunities through outbound prospecting and relationship-building, not solely relying on inbound demand.

  • Sound judgment and ownership in an evolving environment, with an organized approach to pipeline and forecasting.

  • Experience working collaboratively across teams and with external partners to move opportunities forward.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience selling application security, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or software supply chain security.

  • Experience developing a new territory or early-stage market for a software company.

  • Experience co-selling with Japanese resellers, distributors, system integrators, or cloud partners.

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

  • Market competitive salary bands

  • Meaningful equity program

  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

  • Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

  1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

  2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

  3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

  4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

  5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

  6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

title: Werkstudent Business Development (a)
description:
Warum Oviva?

Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen die bestmögliche Unterstützung für ein gesünderes Leben zu bieten. Mit unserer innovativen Kombination aus Verhaltensänderungstherapie und digitalen Tools setzen wir neue Standards in der Gesundheitsversorgung. Oviva schafft skalierbare, zugängliche Lösungen zur Bekämpfung ernährungsbedingter Erkrankungen wie Adipositas und Hypertonie und verbessert so die Gesundheitsversorgung für alle.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Business Development Teams suchen wir dich als Werkstudent:in im Homeoffice.

Die Rolle

Als Teil des Business Development Teams unterstützt du operative Aufgaben und Datenprojekte im Doctor Channel und trägst dazu bei, die Bekanntheit unserer DiGA-Angebote bei Ärzt:innen in Deutschland zu steigern. Deine Arbeit hilft, das Verschreibungsverhalten zu verbessern und die interne Berichts- und Analysefähigkeit zu stärken. Diese praxisnahe Position eignet sich ideal für Studierende, die Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken digitalen Gesundheitsunternehmen sammeln möchten.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Bearbeitung und Beantwortung von Arztanfragen (z. B. Registrierungen über unsere Fachkreise-Seite)

  • Zuordnung von Patienten-Leads zu bestehenden Arztpraxis-Accounts in Salesforce

  • Arbeit mit Salesforce-Berichten zur Unterstützung interner Datenerhebung und -analyse

  • Unterstützung laufender Business Development Projekte und Übernahme kleiner Initiativen

  • Verwaltung von Materialbeständen und Koordination von Nachbestellungen

Was du mitbringst:

  • Eingeschriebene:r Student:in mit mindestens 1 Jahr Reststudienzeit

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau)

  • Interesse an administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Strukturierte, organisierte Arbeitsweise und Lernbereitschaft

  • Grundkenntnisse in Excel oder Motivation, diese auszubauen

  • Im Idealfall Erfahrung mit Salesforce (SalesCloud)

  • Erste Erfahrungen in kundenorientierten oder administrativen Tätigkeiten

Was wir bieten:

  • Wirksame Arbeit im digitalen Gesundheitsbereich

  • Flexible Remote-Arbeit

  • Engagiertes, unterstützendes Team

  • Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:

title: Account Executive, Early Stage - UK&I
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta is growing fast, consistently exceeding our growth targets, and maintaining exceptionally strong NPS scores along the way. Our momentum is driven by a clear mission: to secure the internet and help startups scale with trust. As the category leader in compliance and security automation, we’re capturing market share rapidly, and our Sales team is at the forefront of that charge.

To support this continued growth, we’re expanding our Early Stage Sales team. We’re looking for high-energy, customer-focused Account Executives who thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments and are motivated by the challenge of turning velocity into results. In this role, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle, from first touch to close, and play a critical role in positioning Vanta as the go-to solution for early-stage companies navigating security and compliance for the first time.

This is a highly transactional, new business role where success comes from running a tight, repeatable process and maintaining a high daily output.

If you love the energy of working with startups, are driven to outperform targets, and want to make a tangible impact in a rapidly scaling business, we’d love to hear from you.

This role will be based in our London office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive, Startups - EMEA at Vanta:

  • Identify high-potential business verticals to develop and execute outbound strategies to engage them with Vanta.

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, with a focus on speed and efficiency, aiming to close deals within a 30-day timeframe.

  • Turn our inbound demand into closed-won business quickly and consistently, working across a large number of prospects

  • Operate in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment, running a high number of discovery calls and managing a broad pipeline of opportunities simultaneously.

  • Continuously optimize your sales workflow to maintain high activity levels, improve conversion, and deliver repeatable results.

  • Define and communicate the value of Vanta to prospects, including tailoring sales materials and demos to resonate with early-stage startup buyers

  • Surface product feedback and trends from prospects to inform go-to-market and product development strategies.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 12+ months in a closing and quota-carrying role, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally focused on SMB or early-stage startups, where short deal cycles and high activity are the norm

  • Thrive in high-velocity sales environments and are energized by repetition, fast decision-making, and a transactional approach to deal flow

  • Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects.

  • Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up.

  • You’re intrinsically motivated, proactive, and resourceful—comfortable taking initiative without needing direction

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

What you can expect as a Vanta'n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Where You’ll Work

Get the best of both worlds at LILT! Dive into dynamic in-office energy 3 days a week, sparking creativity and forging bonds with your awesome team. Then, seamlessly shift gears and crush your to-do list from the comfort of your home base for the rest of the week. It's the perfect harmony of productivity and personal freedom. Want a peek inside? Visit our Careers page!

This position can be based out of our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity.

Authorization to work in the UK is a precondition of employment.

What You’ll Do

LILT is growing quickly and the Enterprise Account Executive role is core to our success. We are looking for a driven, hard-working, and adaptable sales professional who will propel us to new milestones by leveraging their skills, qualities, and experiences to grow our commercial footprint. You will achieve this by selling our platform and services to new customers while also supporting our Customer Success Managers to expand partnerships with larger customers.

While we understand the power of a channel, in order to be successful in this role, you will close your quota through your own outbound efforts. This will require you to be a strong, systematic hunter who uses the latest revenue operations practices and technologies to run the entire sales cycle as well as work in conjunction with our ADR/BDR team. You will build relationships with our champions, business cases with their constituents, and “partnerships” with their businesses.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Uncover, educate, and close prospective customers on time and on forecast that meet company metrics and objectives

  • Become an expert in translating the value of our platform and services to all levels and across all functions, including C-level executives, into the language and metrics of the customer in order to sell the outcome impact to business buyers

  • Set-up and deliver winning POCs in order to convert new, long-lasting customers

  • Provide a weekly accounting of your high-gain activities for continuous improvement as well as maintaining an accurate forecast of your total business

  • Sustain high activity levels across all channels employing tailored, multi-thread outreach

Skills and Experience:

  • Required: Experience selling in the translation & localization industry (required both technology and services) or SaaS with strong services component and offering.

  • 6+ years of proven ability in managing complex 9-15 month sales cycles to the high-end mid-market and enterprise markets with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota, acquiring new complex and highly competitive accounts and successful revenue attainment

  • Consistently booking $250k - $2M deals and exceeding $1.2M+ in annual quotas

  • Equally effective in getting meetings with target customers independently as well as in conjunction with ADR/BDR teams

  • Experience in sourcing and acting as the lead on RFP response, cross-departmental collaboration, and execution

  • Proficient with leading sales tools such as Salesforce, Linkedin Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, Momentum

  • Experience in account management and collaborating with cross-functional service & delivery teams to influence strategy and creatively solve client’s business problems

  • Skilled at negotiating business terms with line-of-business, procurement and contract teams, senior management and/or C-level executives

  • Proven ability to influence & drive cross-departmental strategy and collaboration (Services, Product, Solutions, Senior Leadership) during deal cycles in creatively solving our client’s business problems

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and excels leading in-person meetings and web-based demos

  • Process and solution oriented with a customer mindset and ability to challenge the status quo in order to uncover and prove out multiple land and expand use cases

  • BA or BS degree (preferred) or higher from an accredited university

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. They were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company and left to start a new company to address this need – LILT.

At its core, LILT has always been a machine learning company since its incorporation on March 6, 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, believing that this foundation was imperative to the future of enterprise translation.

Benefits:

US Postings

  • Compensation: At market salary with the opportunity to earn on-target earnings (OTE), meaningful equity, 401(k) matching, and flexible time off plus company holidays

  • Medical Benefits: Employees receive coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance, and more. In addition, LILT pays for basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability

  • Paid parental leave is provided after 6 months.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.
