description:
Job title: Delivery Architect (SAP WM)

Employment: Permanent

Location: UK-Based, Remote

Salary: Excellent basic salary depending on experience

Benefits: 24 days holiday, paid birthday day off, paid volunteer day, holiday buy & sell, Bupa private healthcare, 5% employer matched pension contribution, life insurance 4x annual salary, electric car lease scheme, funded social events, investment in personal development, you chose the charity we make the financial contribution, CSR initiatives, and much more!

Are you an experienced SAP WM Consultant or Solution Architect looking to take ownership of solution design while working with innovative SAP software products?

At The Config Team, we're looking for a Delivery Architect (SAP WM) to lead delivery of our software solutions including the design for enhancements across multiple customer projects. You'll play a key role in helping organisations optimise warehouse operations through the implementation of TCT's, SAP software products.

Unlike large-scale transformation programmes that can run for years, our software projects are typically 3-4 months delivered remotely. This offers a great mix of variety, flexibility and work-life balance, while allowing you to apply your SAP WM expertise and lead successful customer implementations.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead the end-to-end solution design for TCT software implementations within SAP WM environments

  • Work across multiple concurrent customer projects, ensuring solutions align to business requirements and TCT best practice

  • Guide delivery teams through blueprint, configuration, testing, deployment and hypercare

  • Ensure solution alignment across functional, technical, integration, data and change workstreams

  • Act as the design authority for customer solutions, identifying and mitigating risks throughout delivery

  • Translate customer warehouse and logistics requirements into scalable, supportable SAP solutions

  • If required support pre-sales activities including customer workshops, solution assessments, RFP responses and Statements of Work

  • Contribute to product development by evaluating new SAP capabilities and industry trends

  • Provide leadership, mentoring and governance across project teams

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Strong hands-on SAP WM experience gained within consulting or client-facing delivery environments

  • Experience delivering SAP WM solutions across multiple implementation or transformation projects

  • SAP ECC6 and/or S/4HANA experience

  • Excellent understanding of warehouse and logistics business processes

  • Strong SAP solution architecture and design capability

  • Experience leading cross-functional SAP delivery teams

  • Ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels

  • Experience working within SAP Activate, Agile, Waterfall or PRINCE2 delivery frameworks

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Desirable

  • SAP S/4HANA Cloud experience

  • Experience working with SAP-integrated software products

  • Pre-sales and commercial consulting experience

  • Proven experience in mentoring 

Why Join The Config Team?

As one of the UK's leading SAP consultancies, we help some of the world's best-known organisations transform their operations using SAP and our own innovative software solutions.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on a variety of customer projects rather than a single programme

  • Influence solution strategy and software innovation

  • Collaborate with highly experienced SAP professionals

  • Develop your architecture and leadership skills

  • Work with proven SAP software products that deliver real customer value

  • Be part of a collaborative, supportive and growing team

If you're passionate about SAP Warehouse Management, solution design and delivering exceptional customer outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today

If the above speaks to you on a professional and personal level then further your career by applying and visit our website to find out more.

Our people are our greatest asset. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment built on trust, respect, and integrity, where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We strive to create a workplace where all individuals feel welcome, safe, valued, and supported.

We are committed to preventing discrimination of any kind and actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those from underrepresented groups. To ensure you can perform at your best during the hiring process, we are happy to accommodate any reasonable adjustments you may need.

For a full job description or if you have any questions, please submit your CV.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
description:
Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales

Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi

Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.).

Contexte et missions

Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale.

Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales.

Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins.

Le stage constituera ainsi une première étape consacrée à la localisation optimale de professionnels de santé, avant une intégration ultérieure de ce problème dans les modèles de districting développés dans le cadre de MATAARI.

Dans un premier temps, le.la candidat.e développera un modèle de Facility Location Problem (FLP) intégrant notamment l’offre et la demande de soins, les indicateurs d’accessibilité, les spécificités territoriales et sociales, qui pourront être éclairées par les travaux de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en sciences humaines et sociales travaillant également sur le projet. Une attention particulière sera portée à la non-linéarité du problème.

Dans un second temps, le modèle de localisation sera adapté dans une perspective d’intégration au problème de districting territorial développé dans le projet MATAARI. Il s’agira d'identifier comment les décisions de localisation de l’offre médicale peuvent être intégrées aux décisions de découpage du territoire afin de construire un modèle hiérarchisé ou intégré.

L’objectif final est ainsi de disposer d’un modèle de localisation autonome pouvant constituer un module d’optimisation de l’offre de soins, intégrable ultérieurement aux modèles de maillage territorial développés par les autres acteurs du projet.

État de l’art

Les problèmes de localisation d’infrastructures (Facility Location Problems) constituent une famille classique de problèmes de recherche opérationnelle visant à déterminer l’implantation optimale d’un ensemble d’infrastructures afin de répondre à une demande distribuée spatialement [2], [3]

De nombreuses variantes ont été développées, notamment les problèmes de p-median, set covering, maximal covering location problem et capacitated facility location. Ces modèles ont été largement mobilisés dans le domaine de la santé pour étudier l’implantation d’hôpitaux, de centres de soins ou de professionnels de santé [4], [5]

Dans le contexte médical, les modèles de localisation doivent toutefois intégrer des caractéristiques spécifiques : demande hétérogène, capacité limitée des professionnels, accessibilité spatiale, distances maximales, concurrence entre sites et incertitude sur l’offre médicale. Une réflexion sur la définition et la mesure de l’accessibilité permettra de proposer une modélisation plus fine des interactions entre la localisation de l’offre de soins, les distances et les besoins des populations. Le problème étudié dans le cadre de ce stage se situe ainsi à l’intersection des problèmes de localisation, des problèmes d’accessibilité spatiale et des problèmes d’organisation territoriale des soins.

Une seconde dimension concerne le lien avec les problèmes de districting et de territory design [6], [7].

Alors que ces derniers cherchent principalement à construire des territoires cohérents sous différentes contraintes géographiques et démographiques, le couplage avec un problème de localisation permet d'introduire explicitement la question de l'organisation de l'offre de soins au sein de ces territoires.

Ce couplage constitue une étape importante vers le développement d'un modèle de maillage territorial adapté aux spécificités des zones rurales.

Profil recherché

Nous cherchons un.e candidat.e en M2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, spécialisé.e en Recherche Opérationnelle, Optimisation Combinatoire, Informatique ou domaine connexe.

Compétences attendues :

  • Formalisation de problèmes complexes (PL, PLNE)

  • Compétences solides en algorithmique et programmation (de préférence Python)

  • Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais pour la documentation et la communication des résultats

Modalités

Date de début : à partir de février 2027 (flexible)

Durée : 5-6 mois

Laboratoire : Centre Génie Industriel, IMT Mines Albi.

Lieu : Albi

Contact

Pour toute question concernant le stage, contactez Cléa Martinez ----- candidater, envoyez votre CV, lettre de motivation, et notes de master à Cléa Martinez (

Références

[1] M. Barlet, « L’Accessibilité potentielle localisée (APL) : une nouvelle mesure de l’accessibilité aux soins appliquée aux médecins généralistes libéraux en France », Etudes et recherche 124, 2012.

[En ligne]. Disponible sur: https://drees.solidarites-sante.gouv.fr/sites/default/files/2020-10/dter124.pdf

[2] C. S. ReVelle, H. A. Eiselt, et M. S. Daskin, « A bibliography for some fundamental problem categories in discrete location science », European Journal of Operational Research, vol. 184, no 3, p. 817‑848, févr. 2008, doi: 10.1016/j.ejor.2006.12.044.

[3] Z. Drezner et H. W. Hamacher, Facility Location: Applications and Theory. Springer Science & Business Media, 2004.

[4] W. Gu, X. Wang, et S. E. McGregor, « Optimization of preventive health care facility locations », Int J Health Geogr, vol. 9, no 1, p. 17, mars 2010, doi: 10.1186/1476-072X-9-17.

[5] A. Ahmadi-Javid, P. Seyedi, et S. S. Syam, « A survey of healthcare facility location », Computers & Operations Research, vol. 79, p. 223‑263, mars 2017, doi: 10.1016/j.cor.2016.05.018.

[6] J. Kalcsics et R. Z. Ríos-Mercado, « Districting Problems », in Location Science, G. Laporte, S. Nickel, et F. Saldanha da Gama, Éd., Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2019, p. 705‑743. doi: 10.1007/978-3-030-32177-2_25.

[7] S. Yanık et B. Bozkaya, « A Review of Districting Problems in Health Care », in Optimal Districting and Territory Design, R. Z. Ríos-Mercado, Éd., in International Series in Operations Research & Management Science. , Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2020, p. 31‑55. doi: 10.1007/978-3-030-34312-5_3.

title: Architecte Backup et responsable de la Product Unit Backup - FREELANCE
description:
ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un opérateur télécom actif dans le domaine du cloud, un ou une Architecte Backup pour structurer et piloter sa Product Unit Backup.

Vous définissez l’architecture de sauvegarde et de restauration du cloud privé et pilotez l’équipe de moins de 10 ingénieurs DevOps chargée de la mettre en œuvre. La Product Unit s’appuie sur des solutions open source pour maîtriser les coûts, préserver l’indépendance technologique et répondre aux enjeux de souveraineté des données.

Modalités de la mission

  • Contrat — Freelance

  • Démarrage — Immédiat

  • Localisation — Châtillon / Saint-Denis / Rennes

  • Télétravail — Possible 2 jours par semaine

  • Durée — 6 mois renouvelable

Vos missions

Architecture et restauration

  • Définir la stratégie de sauvegarde, d’archivage et de restauration des environnements Proxmox VE et Kubernetes, avec Proxmox Backup Server et Velero.

  • Évaluer et éprouver les solutions open source, notamment Plakar, à travers des preuves de concept.

  • Définir les objectifs de perte de données admissible (RPO) et de délai de reprise (RTO), ainsi que les politiques de rétention, de chiffrement et d’immutabilité.

  • Contribuer aux plans de continuité et de reprise d’activité (PCA/PRA) et aux tests de restauration.

  • Maintenir les dossiers d’architecture et d’exploitation (DAT, HLD/LLD, schémas, matrices de flux), formaliser les standards et défendre les choix techniques devant les instances de gouvernance.

Pilotage de la Product Unit

  • Structurer et lancer la Product Unit Backup, définir sa feuille de route, son catalogue de services et son organisation.

  • Prioriser les travaux, répartir la charge, suivre les déploiements et les migrations et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe DevOps.

  • Travailler avec les équipes produit, sécurité, réseau, stockage et cloud, ainsi qu’avec les fournisseurs et les communautés open source.

  • Suivre le taux de succès des sauvegardes, la conformité et les temps de restauration. Contribuer à l’automatisation et à la veille sur la cyber-résilience.

Profil recherché

  • 8 à 10 ans d’expérience en infrastructures, dont au moins 3 ans comme architecte ou référent technique, avec une expérience confirmée du pilotage d’équipe ou de projets.

  • Maîtrise indispensable de Proxmox VE et de Proxmox Backup Server.

  • Expérience de Kubernetes et de Velero. Connaissance de Plakar ou forte appétence pour cet outil.

  • Maîtrise des architectures de sauvegarde (3-2-1, immutabilité, air gap, déduplication, chiffrement). Pratique de Linux, du cloud privé et du stockage objet compatible S3.

  • Connaissances DevOps (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps) et pratique de l’automatisation (Ansible, Terraform, Bash ou Python).

  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, leadership, pédagogie et capacité à défendre des choix techniques.

La connaissance de VMware ou KVM, les contributions open source et l’anglais technique sont appréciés.

Pour postuler

  • Joignez votre CV à jour.

  • Indiquez votre date de disponibilité.

  • Précisez votre TJM HT.

  • Indiquez votre statut.

  • Précisez votre localisation et le ou les sites sur lesquels vous pouvez intervenir.

  • Décrivez une réalisation avec Proxmox VE et Proxmox Backup Server en précisant votre rôle dans la conception et la mise en œuvre.

title: Aerothermal Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

You will own the full thermal and aerothermal engineering cycle for our UAV platforms: from early design recommendations and simulation to wind tunnel experiments and flight test campaigns. Your work directly impacts the survivability, reliability, and performance of our systems in contested environments. You will be the technical authority on heat transfer, thermal management, and aerothermal interactions across all vehicle programs — working closely with aerodynamics, propulsion, mechanical, and GNC teams to ensure our platforms perform within thermal limits under real operational conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Aerothermal Design & Recommendations: Provide early-stage design guidance on thermal management architecture — including cooling inlet design, heat shield placement, exhaust routing, and surface coatings — to ensure airframes remain within thermal limits across the full flight envelope.

  • Thermal & Aerothermal Simulation: Set up, run, and validate lower fidelity thermal models, simulations and coupled thermal-fluid CFD tools (e.g., OpenFOAM). Model convective, conductive, and radiative heat transfer on internal components (batteries, motors, avionics) and external aerodynamic surfaces.

  • Design Optimization: Drive iterative aerothermal optimization cycles to minimize thermal drag penalty, reduce hotspot intensity, and maximize cooling efficiency. Leverage scripting and automated workflows to sweep design parameters and converge on optimal configurations.

  • Wind Tunnel Test Campaigns: Design, plan, and execute aerothermal wind tunnel experiments. Define instrumentation strategy (thermocouples, heat flux sensors, pressure taps), write test plans, operate test rigs, and lead post-test data analysis and correlation with simulation.

  • Flight Test Campaigns: Contribute to and lead in-flight thermal measurement campaigns. Define DAQ architecture for thermal sensors, develop test matrices, analyze flight data, and correlate with CFD predictions to validate models and sign off thermal margins.

  • Cross-functional Integration: Act as the thermal interface between the aerodynamics, propulsion, mechanical, and GNC teams — ensuring that thermal constraints are reflected in system-level trade-offs and that heat rejection requirements are accounted for in the airframe design.

Requirements

  • Education: B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a strong focus on fluid mechanics and heat transfer.

  • AeroThermal Fundamentals: Solid theoretical grounding in convective, conductive, and radiative heat transfer; boundary layer theory; and viscous flow physics as applied to aircraft surfaces and internal cooling passages.

  • Thermal Simulation Proficiency: Hands-on experience with CFD simulations in at least one major solver (OpenFOAM, Star-CCM+, ANSYS Fluent/CFX, or equivalent). Ability to select appropriate thermal boundary conditions, turbulence models, and mesh strategies for accuracy.

  • Experimental Testing: Demonstrated experience planning and executing thermal measurement campaigns — either in wind tunnel or in-flight — including instrumentation selection, DAQ setup, data reduction, and uncertainty analysis.

  • Python Proficiency: Ability to script data processing pipelines, automate post-processing of thermal simulation outputs, and interface with experimental DAQ systems.

  • Technical Communication: Ability to translate complex aerothermal findings into clear design recommendations for multidisciplinary teams.

Nice to have

  • General Aerodynamic Knowledge: Familiarity with the fundamentals of external aerodynamics — lift and drag generation, pressure distributions, boundary layer behaviour, and flow separation — as applied to fixed-wing or multirotor UAV platforms.

  • RC Knowledge: Hands-on experience building, flying, or tuning RC aircraft or drones — whether fixed-wing, quadcopter, or hybrid configurations.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Stellvertretende Ärztliche Leitung der Ovivamed Clinic
description:
Warum Ovivamed?
Bei Oviva und Ovivamed Clinic verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschliesslich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

Die Rolle

Als Stellvertretende Ärztliche Leitung verbindest du die direkte Arbeit mit Patient:innen mit klinischer Verantwortung. Rund 60% deiner Zeit verbringst du in Konsultationen, in denen du Patient:innen auf ihrem Weg begleitest. Die übrigen 40% arbeitest du eng mit der ärztlichen Leitung zusammen: Du vertrittst sie in Besprechungen und Entscheidungen, unterstützt deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen und bist bei Abwesenheit die erste Ansprechperson für klinische Fragen. Du arbeitest sowohl hybrid sowie wahlweise an einem unserer Praxisstandorte (Zürich, Bern, Basel oder Luzern).

Deine Aufgaben

  • Behandlung: Du führst Konsultationen und medizinische Abklärungen durch und begleitest Patient:innen mit Adipositas und Begleiterkrankungen langfristig, auch mithilfe unserer digitalen Werkzeuge.

  • Qualität: Du achtest auf eine sorgfältige Dokumentation und Abrechnung und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran.

  • Stellvertretung: Du vertrittst die ärztliche Leitung in Fachgremien und bei betrieblichen Besprechungen.

  • Unterstützung im Team: Du begleitest Ärztinnen und Ärzte durch gemeinsame Fallbesprechungen, Hospitationen und gibst ehrliches, wertschätzendes Feedback.

  • Sicherheit: Du unterstützt die Umsetzung medizinischer Richtlinien gemäss den Schweizer Vorgaben (FMH, BAG, Datenschutz) und bist erste Anlaufstelle bei Fragen zur Patientensicherheit.

  • Abläufe: Zusammen mit dem Team Medical Operations sorgst du dafür, dass Termine gut geplant sind und die Versorgung reibungslos läuft.

  • Einarbeitung: Du begleitest neue Ärztinnen und Ärzte in ihren ersten Wochen bei Oviva.

  • Digitale Angebote: Du bringst deine klinische Erfahrung ein, wenn wir neue digitale Funktionen gemeinsam mit unseren Produktteams testen und verbessern.




Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in der Anleitung oder Führung medizinischer Fachpersonen, idealerweise im ambulanten Bereich

  • Fundiertes Fachwissen in Adipositasmedizin, Diabetologie oder Innerer Medizin und Freude an der direkten Arbeit mit Patient:innen

  • Gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens und der ambulanten Tarife (TARDOC bzw. ambulante Tarife)

  • Die Fähigkeit, Abläufe zu verstehen, Engpässe zu erkennen und pragmatische Lösungen umzusetzen

  • Eine klare, einfühlsame Kommunikation, auch in heiklen Situationen

  • Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (Schweizerdeutsch ist von Vorteil, weitere Sprachen sind willkommen)

  • Qualifikation: Facharzttitel FMH in Innerer Medizin oder Endokrinologie/Diabetologie

Was Ovivamed dir bietet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld, in dem sich Strukturen und Prozesse laufend weiterentwickeln.

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, in der das Wohl der Patient*innen im Mittelpunkt steht

  • Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget und attraktive Konditionen bei der beruflichen Vorsorge

  • Moderne Arbeitsmethoden und flexible Arbeitsmodelle

  • Eine offene, wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit und Eigeninitiative fördert

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:

Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb dich noch heute!

#LI-MB1

title: Data & BI Intern
description:
Data & BI Intern

Location: Amsterdam (Hybrid)

Work model: Internship

Team: MOVION Data Team

About Movion

Movion helps digital brands reach and grow audiences through mobile networks around the world. We bring together performance marketing, technology, content and local payment solutions to turn great digital products into successful subscription businesses.

With more than 16 years of mobile expertise and activity in over 45 markets, we work across everything from user acquisition and creative campaigns to payment integrations and revenue optimisation. We also build and distribute our own digital products in gaming, fitness, learning, sports and entertainment.

At Movion, you'll join an international, collaborative team where you can take ownership, learn from people across disciplines and see the impact of your work.

The Role

We're looking for a Data & BI Intern to join our growing Data Team.

This internship offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle, from report planning and development to data transformation, validation and stakeholder communication.

You'll work closely with experienced team members on real business projects, helping to build and improve data solutions that support decision-making across the business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Support the planning, development and maintenance of reports and dashboards

  • Assist with end-to-end data solution delivery, from data extraction to visualisation

  • Help identify, investigate and resolve data quality issues

  • Support data validation and testing activities

  • Contribute to automation and data optimisation initiatives

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and business needs

  • Assist in improving existing reporting processes and data workflows

  • Document data structures, reporting logic and processes where required

Job Requirements

  • Currently studying a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a Data, Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics or related field

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Curious mindset and willingness to learn

  • Good communication skills and ability to work with different stakeholders

  • Comfortable working with data and identifying patterns or issues

  • Strong attention to detail

Nice to have:

  • Experience with SQL

  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar visualisation tools

  • Basic knowledge of Python or other analytical programming languages

  • Interest in data engineering, reporting or business intelligence

What You'll Learn

  • End-to-end data solution delivery

  • SQL and data validation techniques

  • Data visualisation and dashboard development

  • Data transformation and reporting processes

  • Automation and AI applications within data teams

  • Stakeholder management and business communication

  • Exposure to data engineering concepts and data pipelines

What We Offer

  • Hands-on experience working on real business projects

  • Dedicated mentorship and support from the Data Team

  • Exposure to modern analytics, reporting and automation tools

  • A fast-growing international environment with colleagues from 25+ nationalities

  • A culture that values ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement

  • The opportunity to develop practical skills that will support your future career in data and analytics

Movion is proud to be a diverse and equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any characteristic protected by law. Decisions are based solely on job-related factors.

title: Air Account Executive
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon's Air team sells drone and counter-drone systems to police and sheriff's departments. As an Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle in a territory covering South Texas, Missouri, and Illinois: finding the deal, running it, and closing it yourself. You'll work alongside an Axon Key Account Leader and manage the Skydio partnership piece of your deals, so customers get one integrated solution instead of stitching together vendors. This is a build the market role. You'll be one of the first reps selling this product line in your territory, not inheriting a warm book.

What You'll Do

Location: OH

Territory: Indiana, Ohio, Missouri (one combined multi-state territory)

Travel: 75%, including overnight travel within territory

Reports to: Sales Director

  • Sell Axon's drone and counter-drone hardware and software directly to police and sheriff's departments in your territory
  • Build your own pipeline. Work RFPs, Google alerts, and referrals to find agencies that need this technology
  • Run the full sales cycle yourself: first call, demo, the RFP/procurement process, contract, close. This often takes several months given how government buying works
  • Manage the Skydio partnership piece of your deals, so customers get one integrated solution instead of stitching together vendors
  • Work alongside an Axon Key Account Leader who's already selling other Axon gear into these same departments. You sell Air, they sell the rest, on the same accounts
  • Log deals and forecast in Salesforce so leadership can see what's closing and when
  • Be one of the first reps selling this product line in your territory. You're building the market here, not inheriting a warm book

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying tech or SaaS sales experience. You've sourced your own deals and closed them, not just worked inbound
  • Proven success breaking into net-new accounts and winning first-time customers • A track record of hitting or beating quota
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Salesforce or equivalent CRM experience
  • Willingness to travel 75% of the time within your territory, including overnights. This is a field role, you'll be in police departments, not on Zoom
  • Experience selling to government or public-sector buyers is a plus: RFPs, procurement cycles, long sales timelines
  • Familiarity with drone, cloud, or virtualization technology is a plus

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all
  • Medical, Dental, Vision plans
  • Fitness Programs
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness support
  • Learning & Development programs
  • And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com. Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers. If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

title: SOX AI Specialist (Contractor)
description:
About us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of advisory, audit, and tax practitioners at the world’s largest CPA firms. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re headquartered in San Francisco, California, and backed by top investors, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and others.

About the Engagement

We are seeking an experienced SOX and internal controls practitioner for a paid, short-term contract engagement. This is not a full-time role (at this time).

Over an initial engagement of 8–12 weeks, with the potential to extend, you will work directly with a small, cross-functional group of subject-matter experts, AI engineers, and product partners. You’ll help translate real-world SOX testing judgment into reliable, AI-assisted workflows. This is not a traditional client-delivery audit or attestation role. Your focus will be on prompting and refining AI agents to execute control testing and partnering closely with AI engineers to identify new engineering capabilities to enable better control testing.

Engagement type: Direct contractor

Initial term: 8–12 weeks, with potential to extend

Start date: Immediate

Time commitment: Approximately 40 hours per week

Target rate: $60–$80 per hour, based on experience, with flexibility for an exceptional fit.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with engineering, product, and design teams to translate real-world SOX testing processes into scalable product capabilities.

  • Co-develop AI agents with AI engineers to execute detailed SOX testing by translating SOX testing methodology into specific guidance, decision rules, and examples.

  • Work hands-on with AI agents: write and refine prompts, run controls and evidence through testing workflows, evaluate outputs, and document failure modes.

  • Analyze risk and control matrices and test plans to identify opportunities for improved agentic testing.

  • Develop stress-test scenarios, review and assess AI agent performance, and create detailed error analyses and evaluation criteria.

What We’re Looking For

  • At least four years of hands-on control testing experience in SOX compliance, internal audit, or internal controls, with direct responsibility for control design and testing.

  • Broad experience across a range of control types, industries, and firms, with clear expertise in business process control testing.

  • The ability to consistently explain why a test step, exception, or conclusion passes or fails and to turn that reasoning into clear evaluation criteria.

  • Strong written reasoning: you can explain workflows and decisions step by step and turn professional judgment into clear rules, edge cases, and review criteria.

  • A high degree of comfort and hands-on experience using AI tools, writing prompts, and working with agentic harnesses.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, testing ideas quickly, and changing your approach when the evidence does not support it.

  • Availability for the expected time commitment during the initial engagement.

What We’d Love to See

  • Experience at the senior or manager level reviewing SOX workpapers or coaching testers.

  • A CPA, CIA, or similar relevant credential.

  • Experience across multiple companies, clients, industries, or control environments.

  • Familiarity with both business process controls and ITGCs.

  • Demonstrated interest or experience in creating AI workflows or tools of any kind.

title: Tech Support Specialist I (Spanish Bilingual)
description:
Company Description

Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote-from-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

Department Description

Service Operations is a core function within Palmetto’s Service and Asset Management organization, responsible for post-PTO service and maintenance across the residential solar asset lifecycle. The team ensures system performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction by managing service requests from intake through resolution. This includes remote troubleshooting, site visit coordination, and field execution through both in-house technicians and a national network of service partners.

Service Operations plays a critical role in protecting asset performance and optimizing the cost of service at scale. Our focus is to resolve issues quickly, efficiently, and with high quality—balancing speed, cost, and customer satisfaction while supporting the long-term performance of the assets we manage.

Location

This position will be based remotely in the Philippines.

Summary of Role

The Tech Support Specialist I is responsible for monitoring system performance and resolving service issues through remote troubleshooting across Palmetto’s residential solar portfolio.

This role is the first line of defense in identifying and addressing system underperformance, using monitoring tools, diagnostics, and customer interaction to resolve issues without requiring a site visit whenever possible.

Tech Support Specialists are accountable for quickly identifying root causes, executing effective troubleshooting steps, and determining when escalation to a site visit is necessary. They play a critical role in optimizing service timelines, reducing cost of service, and ensuring a seamless customer experience.

Strategic & Tactical

  • Monitor system performance across the residential solar portfolio, proactively identifying underperforming or non-producing systems through alerting and diagnostic tools.
  • Triage and investigate service cases, validating issues and determining appropriate troubleshooting paths based on system data and known failure modes.
  • Execute remote troubleshooting steps to resolve system issues, including inverter resets, communication troubleshooting, and guiding homeowners through required actions.
  • Maximize remote resolution by identifying and applying effective solutions, minimizing unnecessary site visits.
  • Communicate clearly and empathetically with homeowners to explain issues, guide troubleshooting steps, and set expectations for resolution.
  • Accurately document all troubleshooting steps, findings, and outcomes within Salesforce to ensure clear case history and enable downstream coordination if needed.
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Service Project Coordinators with clear, complete context, including validated scope and recommended next steps.
  • Manage and prioritize service queues to ensure all cases are addressed within defined SLA timelines.
  • Identify trends, recurring issues, and failure patterns across the portfolio, contributing insights to improve monitoring, processes, and product performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Service Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to improve alert quality, reduce false positives, and enhance troubleshooting workflows.
  • Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives to increase remote resolution rates and reduce overall service cost.

Qualifications

  • BS/BA is preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in technical support, customer support, or operations in a high-volume environment.
  • Spanish proficiency is required.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues using data and structured thinking.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate monitoring platforms, CRM systems, and technical tools (Salesforce experience preferred).
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical customers.
  • Attention to detail in documenting cases, troubleshooting steps, and outcomes.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously while maintaining SLA performance.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Experience in residential solar, electrical systems, or field service environments is preferred.
  • Familiarity with OEM monitoring platforms (e.g., Enphase, SolarEdge) is preferred.

Success Defined

Success in this role is measured by the ability to resolve issues quickly and accurately through remote troubleshooting, while ensuring high-quality case handling and seamless escalation when required.

  • Remote Resolution Rate & Timeline
    Achieve target remote resolution rate while maintaining a fast median time to resolution, minimizing the need for site visits and reducing overall service timelines.
  • Troubleshooting Quality & Escalation Accuracy
    Consistently identify root causes and execute effective troubleshooting steps, with clear, complete escalations that enable efficient downstream coordination and minimize rework.
  • Queue Management & SLA Adherence
    Maintain strong performance against SLA targets by effectively prioritizing and managing case queues, ensuring timely response and resolution across all service requests.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Workforce Management Team

Our Workforce Management (WFM) team ensures operational stability by combining smart planning with real-time execution. We forecast demand, develop staffing plans, build schedules, and make adjustments in real time to keep performance on track and minimize disruptions. By protecting service commitments and driving consistency, we help Thumbtack deliver a seamless, reliable experience that builds long-term trust with pros and customers.

About the role

As a Workforce Analyst, you’ll work across the full workforce management cycle — forecasting demand, building schedules, and managing intraday performance — so that customers and pros get reliable, timely support. This hybrid role connects long-range planning with day-to-day execution, giving you a complete view of how staffing decisions shape service outcomes.

You’ll own work of moderate scope with a blend of autonomy and manager support, apply team standards and decision frameworks, and grow your domain expertise by tackling increasingly complex challenges. It’s an ideal next step for a practitioner who wants to build depth across planning, scheduling, and real-time management.

What you’ll do

Forecasting & Capacity

  • Forecast call, case, and task volumes across channels, adjusting for seasonality, campaigns, and business events.

  • Translate forecasts into staffing requirements and capacity plans that balance service performance, utilization, and cost.

  • Compare forecasts against actuals, explain variance, and refine assumptions to improve accuracy over time.

Scheduling & Allocation

  • Build and maintain schedules, shifts, and rotations that meet coverage needs within business constraints.

  • Plan around training, PTO, and project time while keeping scheduling fair and transparent for agents.

  • Allocate staff across queues and skills to meet service goals efficiently.

Intraday Management

  • Monitor real-time queues, adherence, and service levels across channels.

  • Take tactical action when conditions change, such as re-queuing, shift adjustments, or overtime, weighing service, cost, and agent impact.

  • Communicate status, interventions, and escalations clearly and quickly to operations partners.

Analytics & Recommendations

  • Track utilization, shrinkage, adherence, and forecast accuracy to surface trends and improvement opportunities.

  • Deliver clear reporting and insights that inform headcount planning, budgeting, and operational decisions.

  • Diagnose root causes of performance gaps and propose practical, system-aware improvements.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with Operations, HR, Training, and Finance to keep planning assumptions and cadences aligned.

  • Document assumptions, flag changes early, and maintain reliable planning records others depend on.

  • Contribute to WFM processes and team initiatives that improve how we work.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 3+ years of experience in workforce management, with hands-on work in at least two of forecasting, scheduling, and real-time analysis.

  • Solid understanding of demand and staffing drivers, and the judgment to combine data with business context to build realistic forecasts and plans.

  • Calm, sound decision-making when service conditions change quickly, following consistent frameworks while adapting when needed.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using data from multiple sources to find root causes and weigh risks and benefits.

  • Ability to turn data into clear, simple insights and explain the “why” behind recommendations to different audiences.

  • Proficiency with workforce management systems, reporting tools, and spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets).

  • Organized, transparent working habits: documenting assumptions, sharing context early, and following through on commitments.

  • A collaborative, proactive mindset, seeking out best practices and opportunities to improve how the team operates.

title: Inside Sales Representative, Germany (m/f/d)
description:
About Plasmidsaurus

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.

We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.

Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.

Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.

Role Overview

Accelerate Plasmidsaurus's growth in Europe by converting prospective customers into active users and expanding relationships across a broad portfolio of academic, biotech, government, and pharmaceutical accounts. You'll help build a scalable, high-performing inside sales motion that makes Plasmidsaurus the sequencing partner of choice for more scientists and research organizations.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who combines scientific literacy with a consultative, disciplined approach to selling. We're hiring two people for this team.

What You'll Do

Own and grow your book

  • Manage and develop a portfolio of prospective and existing accounts, from first outreach through close.

  • Prioritize across the book using account potential, engagement, usage, and likelihood to convert.

  • Qualify opportunities and run the full sales cycle: position our services, address objections, and close.

  • Drive repeat purchases and expansion in your accounts through service adoption.

Build deep customer relationships

  • Source new customers, including labs, researchers, and institutions, through outbound prospecting, CRM-driven workflows, and Marketing initiatives.

  • Run consultative discovery with scientists, lab leaders, and procurement to understand research needs, workflows, and purchasing intent.

  • Agree with Account Managers on who is the primary contact for each account, based on usage, complexity, and strategic importance.

Bring the company and customer together

  • Work with Account Managers, Technical Sequencing Specialists, Customer Success, and Marketing on aligned messaging, clean handoffs, and a strong end-to-end customer experience.

  • Help Sales leadership define and refine Inside Sales processes, including prospecting, segmentation, prioritization, and performance metrics, as the function scales.

  • Keep CRM records accurate and timely, including lead progression, opportunities, activity, and forecasts.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

You can position our services accurately, including how plasmid and RNA sequencing differ. You're working your book with a clear approach to prioritization, your CRM records are current, and you've run your first handoffs with Account Managers.

First 6 months

You run the full sales cycle on standard opportunities. You have the pipeline to support your quota and you're meeting prospect-to-purchase conversion targets.

First year

You're meeting or exceeding your quota. Customers you've won are placing repeat orders, and you're helping improve how the team prospects and prioritizes.

What You'll Bring

  • Business fluency in German and English, spoken and written.

  • A bachelor's degree in biology, life sciences, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Relevant sales experience: inside sales (preferably in biotech, healthcare, or pharmaceutical sales), field or territory sales, or customer-facing technical support such as field applications, technical sales support, customer success, or scientific support. We hire on demonstrated scope and impact, not years alone.

  • Scientific literacy sufficient to understand sequencing workflows and clearly position the value of our services.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to engage credibly with scientists as well as procurement and business stakeholders.

  • A consultative selling mindset: discovery, needs assessment, and objection handling.

  • Strong judgment and prioritization across a large and varied book of business, and the ability to run several processes with different stakeholders at once.

  • Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot. Experience in a fast-moving or startup environment is a plus.

Ways of Working

  • Build. Think from first principles and build complete solutions. Understand the reason behind a request, even when it isn't what was asked for.

  • Own. Take personal responsibility. Know your top priorities and make your work visible and impactful.

  • Move. Favor speed over perfection. Be decisive, with a bias to action.

  • Participate. Speak up, dissent, and engage. Share ideas early, disagree and commit, and give and receive feedback with care.

  • Inspire. Work with great people and raise the bar for the team.

Location: Remote, Germany.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, genders, ages and abilities. Please don't include a photo, date of birth or salary history with your application.

We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with the job description as we seek out diverse and creative perspectives. Team members who love to learn and collaborate in an inclusive environment will thrive with us. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please let us know at careers@plasmidsaurus.com.

title: ABM Specialist
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on our Customer Growth Marketing team, inside the account-based marketing (ABM) program that drives site expansion within our existing Enterprise and Mid-Market customers.. You will run the campaigns that introduce MaintainX to new sites and departments, keeping the expansion pipeline growing as targets rise.

The role

You will own the execution behind our ABM programs, so we reach more of our named accounts with timely, relevant campaigns.

  • Run our paid ABM programs on LinkedIn and programmatic: build audiences from account lists and signals, shift budget and creative based on engagement, and test new channels as budget grows. Plan and launch coordinated campaigns across webinars, events, email, and direct mail, timed to account activity and Sales priorities, so Sales has a relevant touchpoint when an account shows buying signals.

  • Set up and QA campaigns in our ABM and marketing tools, and keep account and contact data clean so we reach the right people.

  • Write briefs for ads and landing pages for Creative and keep a refresh calendar, so no campaign goes stale.

  • Report on campaign results and bring your own ideas for one-to-few and one-to-one account plays, so we can go after more high-value accounts.

You will work closely with our Senior Manager, ABM, who sets strategy and signal design, and partner with Sales, Customer Success, Events, and Content. Within 6 to 12 months, you will run our paid programs independently, own your pipeline KPIs, and have designed account plays of your own.

About you

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with hands-on paid digital, ABM, or demand generation experience

  • Experience managing paid campaigns, ideally on LinkedIn and programmatic, and optimizing for pipeline quality rather than volume

  • A track record of executing multi-channel campaigns end to end, ideally ABM campaigns

  • Working knowledge of Outreach (or similar) and Salesforce

  • Strong project management across many campaigns and deadlines at once

  • Comfort pulling performance data, spotting trends, and explaining what they mean

  • Initiative and comfort with ambiguity: you do well in a high-growth environment where priorities pivot

Nice to have:

  • Experience with ABM or sales intelligence tools (UserGems, ZoomInfo, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense)

  • Experience with direct mail or other offline ABM tactics

  • Background in industrial or operations software

We offer

  • Work in the physical world. The accounts you target run factories, fleets, and facilities, and when our software works, their lines stay up.

  • A product the industry already loves. Customers who choose us renew and expand, so you are building on something that already wins.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. MaintainX is part of Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), which brings Autodesk’s global reach to the problem we were already solving.

  • An early seat. This program is scaling fast, and the account plays we have not had capacity to run are yours to design.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We hire for what you have shipped, not what your title was. You get autonomy and the trust to use it, and we expect you to bring ideas rather than wait to be asked. Priorities shift in a company growing this fast, and we say so openly.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Account Executive - Operators
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

About Operators at MaintainX

Machine operators, line workers, and other frontline crews far outnumber maintenance technicians on most plant floors, and they touch the equipment every shift. The MaintainX operator module puts them on the same platform as maintenance.

The Account Executive – Operators will be dedicated to operator sales, helping manufacturers bring their whole frontline workforce onto MaintainX.

Role Overview

As an Account Executive – Operators, you will own the sales motion for expanding MaintainX to operators, which is an important area of growth and already has meaningful revenue. You will join deals owned by our Account Executives, Account Managers and Account Directors to find the frontline workforce inside each customer, size it, build the business case, and close.

You will work with plant and operations leaders to expand MaintainX across their sites.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product and Marketing, and what you hear in the field will shape how we sell and build for operators. This is a “Co-Sell” position, working with MaintainX Sellers and working with the Senior Manager, New Product Sales to build out the Operator sales motion playbook.

What You'll Do

Own the Operators sales motion

  • Run the operator side of deals alongside the account owner: discovery, seat sizing, business case, demos, trials, pricing, and close.

  • Follow up quickly on leads and turn them into qualified pipeline.

  • Partner with Account Managers, Account Directors and CSMs on prospecting to find operator expansion in existing customers, and with AEs to add operators to new deals.

Deeply understand the plant floor

  • Engage plant, operations, EHS and maintenance leaders to learn where opportunities exist to add operators to MaintainX.

  • Map customer use cases to MaintainX, including TPM and autonomous maintenance, pre-use inspections, quality checks, and problem reporting.

  • Quantify impact in downtime and micro-stoppages avoided, scrap and rework reduced, paperwork hours saved, and safety gains.

Run trials and pilots that prove value

  • Structure trials and pilots that prove value fast and set up a broader rollout.

  • Work with Solutions Consultants, CSMs and Implementation to define success criteria, timelines, and rollout plans.

  • Translate trial results into clear business outcomes and ROI for plant and operations leadership.

Tell a differentiated story

  • Deliver tailored demos and executive presentations that show operators and maintenance working in one system.

  • Position MaintainX against paper, standalone checklist apps and other vendors.

  • Share field feedback and competitive insights with Product and Marketing to sharpen messaging and inform the operator roadmap.

Operate with excellence

  • Keep operator opportunities and forecasts clean and current in Salesforce.

  • Hand off cleanly to Implementation and Customer Success so operators are live soon after the deal closes.

  • Help shape the Operators sales playbook: coach account teams on operator discovery, pricing and objection handling, and bring what works back to sales enablement.

About You

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including selling into manufacturing, logistics, food & beverage or other asset-intensive environments.

  • Hustle mentality - “If you lose a day, you lost a week. If you lose a week you lost the month. If you lose a month, you lost the quarter.”

  • A track record of beating quota, ideally including expansion deals in existing accounts.

  • Strong value selling and discovery skills, especially sizing a frontline workforce and building an ROI case around downtime, quality, labor and safety.

  • Comfortable as an overlay: you join deals other sellers own, add value from the first call, and help the MaintainX sales team win.

  • Clear, confident presenter to plant managers and operations executives, comfortable running a live demo on a phone.

  • Highly organized, with strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline.

  • You like building something new: testing plays, keeping what works, and helping write the playbook as it takes shape.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

title: Sales Engineer II | EDU
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Sales Engineer II’s (SE II) primary role is to partner with the Sales Department and work alongside Account Executives to achieve sales and billings goals, with a focus on education customers, including K-12 school districts and higher education institutions. This position will evaluate technical requirements of education opportunities and present technical solutions that help schools, districts, and campuses deliver secure, well-managed Apple device programs for students and staff.

This is a remote position available to individuals residing in the Midwest Territory areas. While the role is remote, you may be asked to work occasionally from the Jamf office or a local collaborative workspace alongside other Jamf team members for key events or important in-person engagements. Please note that we are only able to consider applicants who are currently based in the Midwest Territory areas.

What you can expect to do this role:

  • Customer Facing Responsibilities
    • Work jointly with the Jamf Sales team, prospective and existing education customers, and partners to convey the business value of Jamf in classrooms, districts, and campuses
    • Gain a clear understanding of education customer requirements, such as student and staff device lifecycle, instructional app deployment, student privacy, and compliance obligations, and clearly outline how to address those requirements via the Jamf Portfolio
    • Own all presales technical activities by providing presentation, demonstration, and evaluation experiences tailored to educational environments for prospective and existing customers
    • Cultivate and maintain long-term relationships with K-12 and higher education customers to progress Jamf portfolio awareness and investmen
  • SE Team Responsibilities
    • Contribute to special projects as assigned by SE Management to support initiatives that progress the Sales Engineering org, including education market initiatives, and Jamf as a whole
    • Supports and promotes a positive, inclusive workplace one in which the talents and strengths of our increasingly diverse workforce are welcomed, further developed, and manifested in our wor
  • Personal Responsibilities
    • Amass, and maintain knowledge of value and technical capabilities of all products in the Jamf portfolio,with particular depth in education workflows such as Apple School Managet, Managed Apple Accounts, and shared 1:1 device programs
    • Exhibit professional and timely written oral communication
    • Perform all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and the vision of the organization
    • #LIRemote

What we are looking for:

  • 3-5 years of technical sales, support, or services experience (Required)
  • Basic knowledge of the Jamf products (Preferred)
  • Basic understanding of Apple Enterprise Management technologies (Preferred)
  • Technical knowledge of typical security architecture, application security and identity management (preferred)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Experience in a commercial, government, or education environment


Education and Certifications

  • 4 Year / Bachelor's Degree (Required)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

For sales and commission-based roles, we post On-Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus estimated commission based on achieving 100% of performance targets. Commission is not guaranteed and varies based on individual performance results.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$73,000—$167,380 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. We are a series C startup with the largest network of independent primary care practitioners for clients.

The Recruiting team is looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Recruiter to help grow teams across Elation Health. This is a fantastic opportunity to build a strong foundation in full-cycle recruiting while working alongside experienced recruiters on our Talent team. If you're eager to learn the craft of recruiting, love connecting with people, and want to help build something meaningful in healthcare technology, this may be the right opportunity for you!

Responsibilities

  • Support full-cycle recruiting across a variety of teams and roles company-wide, from job posting through offer
  • Source and screen candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, Juicebox, referrals, and other creative channels, using AI-powered sourcing tools to identify and engage talent more efficiently
  • Leverage AI tools to streamline resume screening, candidate research, and outreach personalization, while applying good judgment to ensure fairness and accuracy
  • Schedule and coordinate interviews across multiple stakeholders, ensuring a smooth and timely process for candidates and hiring teams alike
  • Help create a fabulous candidate experience by communicating clearly, warmly, and promptly at every touchpoint
  • Keep our applicant tracking system meticulously updated in real time, ensuring accurate candidate status and pipeline data
  • Partner with hiring managers and senior recruiters to understand role requirements and target candidate profiles across departments
  • Be an ambassador of Elation Health's mission and core values throughout the candidate journey
  • Track recruiting metrics and pipeline data, using AI-powered dashboards or reporting tools where available to flag trends or bottlenecks to the team
  • Stay current on emerging AI recruiting tools and best practices, and help evaluate new technologies that could improve our hiring process
  • Take on special projects to improve recruiting processes and candidate experience as you grow in the role
  • Partner across both Talent Acquisition and Human Resources, leveraging periods between active hiring cycles to contribute to core HR programs, retention strategies, and team development

Experience and Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting
  • Effective communication with hiring teams
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, AI sourcing platforms) to work smarter and more efficiently
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail -- you take pride in keeping records accurate and up-to-date
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities and calendars in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive, can-do attitude and a strong sense of ownership over your work
  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow your career over time
  • Experience with HR (Generalist, Employer Relations) strongly preferred

Salary range: $85,000-100,000

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.
