title: Payroll Tax Analyst
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf:

The Payroll Analyst supports accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery for Jamf's U.S. workforce while assisting with payroll processing for Jamf's international workforce. This role processes payroll and standard tax filings under established procedures, supports international payroll vendors on day-to-day matters, and escalates complex or novel tax and compliance issues to senior payroll staff.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Support U.S. payroll tax compliance by preparing standard federal, state, and local tax filings (Forms 941, 940, W-2, and W-3) for review, and assist with reconciling tax liabilities against the general ledger.
  • Process semimonthly U.S. payroll — wages, deductions, benefits, and garnishments — across multiple states in Workday, following established payroll procedures.
  • Research routine payroll tax notices and agency correspondence, escalating complex or novel issues to senior payroll or tax staff.
  • Support year-end processing, including W-2 preparation and reconciliation.
  • Support payroll processing for Jamf employees outside the U.S. by coordinating with in-country payroll providers on day-to-day pay accuracy and timeliness.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned international payroll vendors, flagging discrepancies for review before disbursement.
  • Process and audit garnishments, levies, and voluntary deductions in compliance with applicable law.
  • Coordinate with HR, Legal, and Finance on standard multi-state and multi-country payroll matters, escalating complex tax or compliance questions as needed.
  • Use AI-powered tools alongside other payroll technologies to support validation and reconciliation tasks, flagging anomalies for review.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of federal, state, and local payroll tax rules — FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and withholding (required)
  • Working knowledge of U.S. payroll processing experience (required)
  • Experience with a major payroll platform, such as Workday, ADP Workforce Now, ADP Streamline/Celergo, or UKG (required)
  • Exposure to international payroll processes, ideally partnering with in-country payroll providers or Employers of Record (EORs) (preferred)
  • Experience partnering with One Source Virtual (OSV) or similar payroll service providers to support U.S. payroll processing (preferred)
  • Proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables) for reconciliations and reporting (required)
  • Comfort using AI-powered tools to support payroll validation and reconciliation tasks (preferred)

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree (preferred)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered (required)
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification, or an international payroll equivalent (preferred)

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Mental Well-being
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News
  • We know that big ideas can come from anyone, so we empower everyone to make an impact. Our 90% employee retention rate agrees!
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • Our volunteer time off allows employees to support and give back to our communities.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

#LIRemote

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$61,000—$95,000 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

title: Strategic Market Management Opportunities (All Levels)
description:
Help Shape Markets. Not Just Respond to Them.

At Turner & Townsend, we're building a globally connected, digitally enabled Strategic Market Management capability that helps clients make better investment decisions, strengthen supply chain resilience and improve delivery confidence across major programmes.

Working across infrastructure, energy, defence, real estate and public sector investment, we help clients understand how markets operate today, anticipate how they may evolve tomorrow, and develop strategies that improve outcomes.

Combining market intelligence, market engagement, strategic supplier relationship management, analytics and commercial insight, we provide the evidence and advice that supports critical investment, delivery and procurement decisions on some of the world's most complex and ambitious programmes.

As our capability continues to grow, we are looking for exceptional people at all levels, from early-career analysts through to senior leaders.

What We Do

Our teams help clients:

  • Understand market capacity, capability and resilience
    - Identify supply chain risks, constraints and opportunities
    - Improve investment and business case decisions through market intelligence
    - Design and deliver effective market engagement strategies
    - Inform commercial, procurement and delivery decisions
    - Develop strategic supplier and ecosystem approaches
    - Monitor market trends, competitive dynamics and future market developments
    - Build confidence in programme affordability, deliverability and market response

Where You Could Contribute

  • Develop market intelligence and analytical insight
    - Assess supplier capability, capacity and market maturity
    - Undertake market research, benchmarking and trend analysis
    - Design and deliver market engagement activities
    - Support strategic sourcing and commercial decision-making
    - Advise clients on market risks, opportunities and interventions
    - Build relationships with suppliers, industry bodies and client stakeholders
    - Lead projects, workstreams and client engagements
    - Develop innovative approaches, digital tools and data-led solutions
    - Help shape the future direction of Strategic Market Management within Turner & Townsend

We welcome applications from people with experience in areas such as:

  • Infrastructure and construction

- Energy and utilities

- Defence and aerospace

  • Real estate
    - Procurement and commercial management
    - Supply chain and logistics
    - Market intelligence and market research
    - Economics
    - Data analytics and business intelligence
    - Strategy and management consulting

- Programme and project delivery

Equally, we recognise that some of the best talent comes from less conventional backgrounds.

We're interested in people who are intellectually curious, analytically minded, commercially aware and motivated by solving complex challenges.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Team

Successful individuals typically demonstrate:

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
    - Commercial awareness and strategic judgement
    - Curiosity about how markets behave and evolve
    - The ability to turn complex information into clear, actionable insight
    - Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
    - A collaborative mindset and willingness to challenge established thinking
    - An interest in the intersection of markets, investment, supply chains and programme delivery

For senior appointments, we're particularly interested in individuals who can build trusted client relationships, lead complex engagements, shape new propositions and support the growth of high-performing teams.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join a capability at a formative stage of growth.

You'll work alongside experts in procurement, commercial strategy, programme delivery, data analytics and digital innovation, helping clients address some of the most significant investment and delivery challenges across global markets.

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to help define what Strategic Market Management becomes, both within Turner & Townsend and across the industries we serve.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at

SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects:

Twitter

Instagram

LinkedIn

It is strictly against Turner & Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. No recruitment agency working with Turner & Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time.

Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorised Recruitment Agency/Search Firm for Turner & Townsend, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by the Recruitment Team, to submit candidates for review.

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.​

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.​

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.​

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.​

title: Legal | Rechtsanwält/in für Mietrecht (x/w/m) - Remote
description:
Hopkins ist eine auf die Rechte von Privatpersonen spezialisierte, deutschlandweit tätige Kanzlei. Gegründet in 2019 durch Arend Liese, zuvor Rechtsanwalt bei Freshfields Bruckhaus Deringer, denkt Hopkins das Prinzip Kanzlei und Rechtsdurchsetzung täglich neu - mit großem Fokus auf moderne Technologie und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit. Mit einem Team von mehr als 150 Personen berät und vertritt Hopkins Privatpersonen deutschlandweit in allen rechtlichen Belangen.

Aufgaben

  • Du etablierst eine neue Ära der Rechtsdurchsetzung und bist Teil der Mission, juristische Prozesse zu digitalisieren und automatisieren

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Beziehung und den Kontakt zu Deinen Mandantinnen und Mandanten und führst rechtliche Beratung und Vertretung im Bereich von mietrechtlichen Fällen durch

  • Du übernimmst die Verhandlungen mit Gegenseiten sowie gegnerischen Anwälten

  • Du erstellst Klageschriften, Schriftsätze, Verträge, etc.

  • Du bearbeitest eigenständig Fälle und vertrittst unsere Mandanten sowohl außergerichtlich als auch vor Gericht

  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen anderen internen Teams zusammen

  • Du gibst Deine Erfahrungen und Dein Feedback in unseren Produktentwicklungsprozess mit ein und arbeitest direkt mit Produktmanagern und der Geschäftsführung an Verbesserungen in der Automatisierung von Abläufen

Qualifikation

Du bist Volljurist:in mit Zulassung zur Rechtsanwaltschaft in Deutschland oder hast diese bereits beantragt. Zudem verfügst Du über mindestens ein Jahr Berufserfahrung (idealerweise im Mietrecht). Deine Arbeitsweise ist pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und Du hast große Lust und Energie, innerhalb eines dynamischen Arbeitsumfelds an der Zukunft des Rechtsmarkts mitzuwirken. Die Vision, in einer durch Technologie skalierbaren Kanzlei mitzuarbeiten, inspiriert Dich und Du denkst gerne darüber nach, wie sich juristische Prozesse durch die Nutzung von Daten und Software verbessern lassen. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und gewissenhaft, setzt dabei klare Prioritäten und legst eine unternehmerische und ergebnisorientierte Denkweise an den Tag. Dazu bist Du lernwillig und übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Arbeit. Deine Stärke in der Kommunikation und Dein Verhandlungsgeschick zeichnen Dich aus.

Benefits

  • Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, als Protagonist die Anwaltskanzlei der Zukunft zu formen und die Welt der Rechtsdienstleistungen für Privatpersonen grundlegend zu verändern

  • Du übernimmst schnell viel Verantwortung für unsere Kanzlei und sammelst für Deinen Fachanwaltstitel in kurzer Zeit viele relevante Fälle

  • Du arbeitest von dort, wo Du am produktivsten bist: Unser Team ist in Deutschland verteilt und arbeitet zum Großteil remote. Wir haben aber natürlich auch ein Büro in Berlin, in dem Du jederzeit willkommen bist.

  • Du bist Teil eines inspirierenden Teams bestehend aus Experten vieler verschiedener Disziplinen

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Produktmanagern und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast großen Einfluss auf die Technologie, die wir bauen

  • Wir bieten eine attraktive und leistungsbezogene Vergütung

  • Wir übernehmen alle Kosten, die mit Deiner Tätigkeit als Rechtsanwalt sowie dem Erhalt und der Aufrechterhaltung der Zulassung zusammenhängen (Versicherungen, Kammergebühren, etc.)

Insbesondere hast Du große Lust und Energie, in einem Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten zu wirken, Themen aufzubauen und zu verändern. Dabei bist Du inspiriert durch den Gedanken mit Deiner Arbeit Menschen zu ihren Rechten zu verhelfen und Zugang zu erstklassiger rechtlicher Beratung zu ermöglichen.

Wir freuen uns sehr auf ein Kennenlernen, wenn diese Herausforderung Dich anspricht.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Le poste

En tant que Support Operations Specialist, tu rejoindras la Team Customer Success & Delivery. Véritable point de contact de nos clients, tu les accompagneras dans l'utilisation de notre solution en assurant le traitement, le suivi et la résolution de leurs demandes. Tu auras aussi un rôle clé dans le pilotage de l'activité support, en interne comme auprès des clients.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Qualifier et traiter les demandes entrantes (outil de ticketing, e-mail) dans le respect des SLA (anomalies, demandes de support utilisateur, demandes d'évolution, demandes de travaux).

  • Vérifier la complétude des tickets (informations nécessaires, pièces jointes, contexte).

  • Réaliser le diagnostic des incidents (N1/N2) afin de déterminer la nature du besoin.

  • Prendre en charge et résoudre les demandes ne nécessitant ni paramétrage technique ni développement informatique.

  • Assurer la résolution des incidents ou leur escalade vers les équipes Produit ou Tech si nécessaire, en garantissant un transfert clair et documenté.

  • Assurer le suivi des demandes de bout en bout, informer régulièrement les clients et documenter chaque étape.

  • Veiller au respect des niveaux de service (SLA) et relancer les équipes de niveau 2 et 3 si nécessaire.

  • Formaliser la base de connaissances (FAQ, guides, tutoriels) et structurer les macros de réponse.

  • Participer aux tests et aux recettes des nouvelles versions et remonter les retours clients pertinents à l'équipe Produit.

  • Piloter l'activité support : prioriser et suivre les tickets de l'équipe, assurer le reporting et proposer des plans d'amélioration.

  • Animer les points réguliers avec certains clients (mensuels, trimestriels ou annuels) pour présenter le bilan du support sur la période.

Les outils et environnements de travail :

  • Utilisation basique de Base de données (via phpMyAdmin).

  • Maîtrise de Mantis (gestion des tickets).

  • Utilisation de base documentaire et procédures internes.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu es diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+2 à Bac+3 (informatique de gestion, gestion de projet, école d'ingénieur ou équivalent).

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en support logiciel B2B, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS, avec une vraie dimension pilotage : priorisation et suivi des tickets, reporting, actions d'amélioration.

  • Tu as déjà animé des points réguliers avec des clients.

  • Tu comprends les environnements SaaS (web et mobile), tu possèdes des notions d'API et de SSO, et tu sais réaliser des requêtes SQL simples.

  • Tu fais preuve d'un bon esprit d'analyse, de rigueur et de méthode pour diagnostiquer, qualifier et suivre les demandes.

  • Tu sais prioriser tes activités et gérer plusieurs sollicitations en parallèle.

  • Tu as un excellent sens du service client et tu apprécies d'accompagner les utilisateurs dans la recherche de solutions.

  • Tu communiques avec aisance, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques.

  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe et collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme fonctionnels.

  • Tu es organisé(e), réactif(ve) et animé(e) par une démarche d'amélioration continue.

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu parles anglais.

  • Tu as déjà participé à la création ou à la mise en place d'une FAQ.

  • Tu connais les écosystèmes ERP ou SIRH.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où ton expertise et tes actions auront un impact concret sur la satisfaction client.

  • Travailler autour d’un produit reconnu et apprécié par ses clients.

  • Une équipe expérimentée, bienveillante et toujours prête à partager ses connaissances.

Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien téléphonique RH.

  • Première mise en situation : découverte d’une solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais et échange autour de ses fonctionnalités.

  • Seconde mise en situation : l’objectif est d’évaluer les capacités rédactionnelles.

  • Échange avec le Team Lead – Projet, la Head of Delivery et le Project Manager.

Poste basé à Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour de télétravail par semaine. Les 3 premiers mois, une présence quotidienne sur site est demandée pour faciliter ton intégration.

Rémunération : 34k à 36k€ brut annuel selon le profil.

description:
Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.

As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas.

Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition.

You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative.

What You Will Do:

Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient.

Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth.

Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages.

Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate.

Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights.

Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities.

Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI.

Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives.

What You Bring To The Role:

2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry.

Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Our Benefits:

Annual remote expense budget.

Flexible PTO.

Paid parental leave.

Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteranâs status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

description:
Du siehst keine passende Stelle, möchtest aber trotzdem Teil der BBHT werden? Dann bewirb Dich initiativ bei uns.

Vielleicht bist Du IT-Projektleiter:in, Business Analyst:in, Consultant, Softwareentwickler:in, Testmanager:in oder bringst ganz andere Skills mit, die zu uns passen? Wir sind immer offen für Menschen, die Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns Softwareentwicklungsprojekte voranzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.


Warum BBHT?

  • Flexibilität (keine Office-Pflicht)

  • Bezahlte Überstunden (Was du leistest, wird auch anerkannt)

  • Mentoring ab Tag 1 (Du startest nie allein)

  • Great Place To Work (Eine Kultur, auf die wir stolz sind)

Das erwartet Dich

Wir arbeiten an Softwareentwicklungsprojekten in den Branchen Banken und Versicherungen.

Dabei kannst Du Deine Erfahrung dort einbringen, wo Du am meisten bewegen kannst, zum Beispiel in:

  • IT-Projektmanagement & IT Projektleitung

  • IT-Business-Analyse & Requirements Engineering

  • Softwareentwicklung & Architekturberatung

  • Softwaretest & Testautomatisierung

Was uns wichtig ist: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bringst Deine Ideen ein und gestaltest gemeinsam mit uns die passenden Lösungen für unsere Kunden.

Was Du bekommst

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • 30 Tage Urlaub & Workation

  • MacBook & iPhone

  • JobRad & HanseFit

  • Individueller Weiterbildungsplan & Karrierepfad

  • Regelmäßige Veranstaltungen (Thementag, Community Days, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier u.v.m.)

Wen wir suchen

Du passt wahrscheinlich gut zu uns, wenn du

  • mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der IT Beratung, bestenfalls im Bereich Banken- und Versicherungen mitbringst,

  • bereits Erfahrungen in agilen Softwareentwicklungsprojekten sammeln konntest,

  • komplexe fachliche und technische Themen verständlich erklären kannst,

  • selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert arbeitest,

  • gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und dich durch eine offene und empathische Kommunikation auszeichnest,

  • Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns besser zu werden,

  • über fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) verfügst.

Über uns

Bei uns gilt das Prinzip „voneinander, füreinander.“ Das ist kein Leitbild für die Wand, sondern die Art, wie wir zusammenarbeiten.

Du kannst bei uns Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und Dinge wirklich mitgestalten. Eigeninitiative und proaktives Handeln werden nicht nur erwartet, sondern gesehen und wertgeschätzt. Jede Person bringt ihre eigenen Stärken und Interessen ein und genau daraus entsteht unser gemeinsamer Erfolg.

Wir glauben daran, dass gute Beratung nur mit einem starken Team funktioniert. Deshalb sind unsere Türen jederzeit offen, wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und teilen Wissen statt Konkurrenzdenken zu fördern. Neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen starten mit einem persönlichen Mentoring, das den Einstieg leicht macht und von Anfang an Sicherheit gibt.

Noch unsicher?

Bewirb dich nicht sofort.

Lern uns erst kennen.

Wir bieten dir ein unverbindliches Kaffee-Date.

Keine Verpflichtung, Einfach ein ehrliches Gespräch.

Jetzt bewerben

Wenn du Beratung suchst, bei der Leistung zählt - aber Menschen wichtiger bleiben - freuen wir uns auf dich.

title: People Partner (all genders)
description:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

People Partner (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

At tonies, storytelling is at the heart of everything we do. Our success isn't just about innovative technology and creative ideas - it's about the passionate, talented people who bring those stories to life. As we scale, we are looking for a People Partner to join our journey and shape our next chapter. In this role, you’ll be part of our People Partnering team, with the ambition to build high-impact teams through collaborative partnerships and a high-performance culture as an engine for long-term business success.

What you'll do

Driving Organizational Effectiveness through Strategic People Partnering

  • Partner closely with leadership in your designated area across various levels, acting as a trusted strategic advisor on a broad range of people and organizational matters.

  • Support the evolution of your area by contributing to organizational design matters and the implementation of structural changes.

Coaching Leaders to Lead with Impact

  • Act as a coach and sparring partner to leaders, supporting their leadership effectiveness.

  • Help leaders navigate organizational and cultural change, make thoughtful leadership decisions, and drive high-performance within their teams.

Driving the Implementation of People Programs

  • Partner with the people development function to drive the implementation and adoption of people programs within your designated area.

  • Support leaders and teams through change and take ownership of core programs, e.g performance feedback, ensuring effective delivery and desired outcomes.

Navigating Employee Relations with Empathy and Expertise

  • Support the resolution of employee relations matters, including conflict resolution, disciplinary actions, and sensitive workplace dynamics (either directly or in close collaboration with our Employee Relations Specialist).

  • Ensure situations are handled thoughtfully, consistently, and in line with our values and legal requirements.

Creating a Seamless Employee Experience through Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with cross-functional People & Culture teams to ensure a seamless employee experience and embed cohesive ways of working between the business and our department.

What You Bring

  • Multiple years of experience as a People Partner in a complex global company, ideally in a fast-paced, scaling context, with deep experience in partnering with leaders across different countries, including the US.

  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking to understand how different business areas operate, connect people priorities with business needs, and confidently act as a trusted advisor to leaders.

  • Strong collaboration and cross-functional partnership skills, working effectively as a team player with stakeholders at multiple levels across the organization.

  • Clear, confident, and empathetic communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences, build trusted relationships, and create alignment on complex or sensitive topics.

  • Action-oriented ownership to proactively drive topics forward, navigate obstacles, and ensure initiatives are successfully implemented to achieve desired outcomes.

  • Skilled at systemic thinking and problem-solving, understanding how people, processes, and structures interconnect to identify underlying patterns and develop thoughtful, sustainable solutions.

  • Global mindset and flexibility to thrive in an international setup, including early-evening meetings when needed to collaborate with US-based colleagues as well as occasional business trips to Düsseldorf

  • Full professional fluency in English and German

  • Ideally, experience working with works councils and navigating the associated processes and requirements.

Why Join Us?

  • Global teamwork: We work together across departmental and national borders on our vision of bringing the Toniebox to every child's room in the world.

  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code, but to everything else as well. Because you can only give your best when you feel truly comfortable.

  • Mobility: Choose the offer that best suits you – a Germany ticket for unlimited mobility, a monthly payment of fifty euros for an office parking space, a leased bicycle or a remote work allowance.

  • Protection: Benefit from subsidies for employee savings plans, company pension schemes and disability insurance.

  • Relaxation & Time Out: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave plus three additional days off, such as Carnival Monday, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also take up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave).

  • Continuous professional development: Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge.

  • Language learning and relaxation made easy: Improve your communication skills with the Babbel language learning app and find relaxation through our access to the Calm meditation app.

  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire tonies range.

 

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Propellant Quality Control Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Propellant Quality Control Engineer to ensure the quality, consistency, and traceability of the materials and processes used to manufacture our solid propellants. Working closely with the Lead Propellant Manager, laboratory technicians, propulsion engineers, manufacturing, and suppliers, you will define and execute quality-control activities from incoming raw materials through to finished propellant.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical judgement with a disciplined approach to measurement, documentation, investigation, and process control. Your work will help ensure that propellant development and production remain safe, repeatable, and aligned with the required performance standards.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and perform quality-control checks for raw materials, intermediate products, and finished propellant.

  • Develop and maintain inspection plans, test methods, acceptance criteria, sampling requirements, and quality records.

  • Review laboratory and production data to identify trends, variation, out-of-specification results, and emerging process issues.

  • Lead or support investigations into non-conformances, deviations, material issues, and unexpected test results.

  • Maintain clear traceability of materials, batches, samples, equipment, results, and technical decisions.

  • Work with the Lead Propellant Manager and manufacturing teams to improve process capability, measurement quality, and production consistency.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in quality control, quality engineering, laboratory testing, or process control within a chemical, aerospace, manufacturing, or other regulated environment.

  • A degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of measurement systems, test methods, sampling, data review, and technical documentation.

  • Experience investigating non-conformances, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions.

  • A methodical and detail-oriented approach to safety, traceability, data integrity, and compliance.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with laboratory, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.

Desirable experience

  • Solid rocket propellants, energetic materials, Elastomers, polymers, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, or catalysts.

  • Propellant or chemical-material characterisation, including thermal, mechanical, rheological, chemical, or burn-rate testing.

  • Incoming-material inspection, supplier quality, batch release, certificate-of-analysis review, or material qualification.

  • Statistical process control, measurement-system analysis, capability studies, trend analysis, or uncertainty assessment.

  • Experience with hazardous chemicals, explosives, regulated materials, or formal laboratory and manufacturing quality systems.

  • Python, MATLAB, laboratory information systems, electronic records, or other tools for quality and test-data analysis.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: Entrepreneur in Residence | Working Student (m/w/d)
description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

As an Entrepreneur in Residence Working Student at CONROO, you will turn ideas into business opportunities and help shape the future of our company. Working closely with our founding team and Sales team, you will explore untapped markets, build new business areas from the ground up, and translate strategic ideas into actionable solutions.

🎖️What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You will collaborate closely with the founding team to explore new business opportunities and strategic initiatives.

  • You will conduct in-depth analyses and prepare decision-making frameworks for the founding team.

By 3 months

  • You will identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities and untapped market potential.

  • You will develop innovative strategies and actionable proposals to improve our operations and expand our market presence.

  • You will oversee and optimize the execution of marketing campaigns, track performance metrics, and ensure alignment with business goals.

By 6 months

  • You will collaborate with the founding team to develop and launch new business areas from the ground up.

  • You will support cross-departmental initiatives that contribute to the company's growth.

  • You will continuously explore emerging trends and technologies to keep our offerings at the forefront of the logistics and IT sectors.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Information Technology, Logistics, Sales, Marketing, or a related field

  • You have relevant professional experience in entrepreneurship, business development, strategy, or project management.

  • You have excellent written and spoken skills in English.

  • You have strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

  • You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • You take ownership of your work, and are motivated to take on responsibility and make a meaningful impact.

  • You continuously look for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • You bring a hands-on mindset, with a 'never-stop-learning' attitude and a desire to grow alongside the team

  • You take accountability for your tasks, follow through on commitments, and proactively address challenges.

This role is based in our Munich office, with at least 2-3 days per week on site.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team events where we work, unwind, and connect. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application review

  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind.

  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45 minute interview with the CEO & hiring manager, Felix.

  4. Complete a take-home case study.

  5. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview at our Munich office, where you’ll present your case study and discuss your experience further with our CEO, Felix, and COO, Ksenia.

We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustments to participate in an interview or assessment, please let our recruitment team know so we can discuss suitable arrangements.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

title: Flight Control Intern - Stabilizing Unstable Aircraft
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

Responsibilities
Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts.

  • Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes.

  • Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range.

  • Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results.

  • Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware.

  • Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins.

  • Quantify the performance envelope, including the limits set by actuator bandwidth, sensor noise and latency, and the agility gained in return.

  • Build a reusable toolchain: a Python simulation workflow (for example JSBSim or Gazebo) validated on flight data, hardware-in-the-loop tests, flight test procedures and a data analysis pipeline.

  • Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.

Candidate Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Control, Robotics, or a related field.

  • Solid foundations in flight mechanics and control theory, ideally with experience in system identification or stability analysis.

  • Proficiency in Python. C/C++ and embedded firmware experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on building experience, such as RC aircraft, drones, or any fabrication project. Familiarity with PX4 or ArduPilot is a plus.

  • Comfort with flight testing, debugging in the field, and learning from the occasional crash.

  • Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Inertial Navigation Engineer Intern
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing advanced autonomous systems that rely on robust state estimation and sensor fusion to operate in complex, dynamic environments. Our platforms integrate multiple sensors (e.g., IMU, GNSS, vision, barometer, magnetometer) and require accurate, real-time estimation of system states (position, velocity, attitude, etc).

Classical approaches such as Kalman filtering are powerful but rely on modeling assumptions that often break down in real-world conditions. To push performance beyond these limits, we are exploring hybrid approaches that combine model-based estimation with modern machine learning techniques.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to explore and apply machine learning-based sensor fusion and state estimation methods to improve performance in dynamic environments.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Conduct a comprehensive review of existing ML methods for state estimation and sensor fusion.

  • Algorithm Implementation: Develop and implement various algorithms based on the literature review and project requirements using simulated and real-world flight data.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and computational overhead of the developed algorithms with classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results, and conclusions.

  • Flight Tests Participation: Actively participate in flight test sessions to gather real-world data and validate the effectiveness of the developed algorithms in operational conditions. Contribute to real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record in applied mathematics, machine learning, robotics or a related fied. Knowledge of sensor fusion/state estimation is a strong plus.

  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of ML fundamentals. Experience with State Estimation, drones, or Control Theory is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Internship - 3D Graphics for Robotics
description:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include:

  • Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions

  • Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds

  • Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping

  • Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms

  • Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware

What we expect from you

  • Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development

  • Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization)

  • Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA)

  • Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome)

Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer vision. Because our graphics work is tightly coupled with our perception stack, strong vision fundamentals will let you have an even bigger impact:

  • Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry

  • Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation

General

  • Full-time availability during the internship period.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

What can we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

title: Workforce Management - Real Time Analyst
description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Overview

📍 Remote Global - APAC

We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model.

The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You won't just report that a queue is at risk; you will diagnose the business impact, identify the root cause, and prescribe the specific levers leadership must pull to preserve SLA and the customer experience. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us.

Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken.

  • Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density.

  • Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated.

  • Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability.

  • Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions.

  • Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations.

  • Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns.

  • Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks.

  • Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team.

  • Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty

  • You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model.

  • Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions.

  • Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents

  • Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner.

Hiring Process

  • Application

  • Case Study

  • Interview with Central WFM - RTA Team Lead

  • Interview with Queue Operations Manager - Core Services

  • Interview with Head of Core Services

  • Final Culture Interview with Executive Leadership

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.
